sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Frequently Asked Questions Straight answers from our factory team — MOQ, lead time, finishes and protection. How does a collapsible magnetic gift box save on shipping? The box ships flat-packed and is assembled on demand, which can reduce shipment volume and storage needs compared with pre-assembled rigid boxes. The actual freight effect depends on carton dimensions, packed quantity, destination, and carrier rules. What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for collapsible magnetic gift boxes? The listed starting MOQ for this collapsible magnetic format is 300 pieces. Confirm the selected size, wrap, finish and insert against that quantity in the written quotation; it is not a company-wide minimum. What finishes and decoration options are available? Options include gold foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, soft-touch matte and gloss lamination, CMYK offset printing, and ribbon accents, all with a luxury magnetic closure. How fast can LuxoPack produce samples and bulk orders? Confirm whether the sample is structural, printed or production-equivalent, then request its cost and timing. Bulk scheduling depends on material readiness, quantity and sample approval; use the dates confirmed for your project rather than a universal lead time. How is a collapsible magnetic gift box assembled? The flat-packed panels are opened along the scored fold lines, the side walls are squared and secured, and the magnetic flap is closed to check alignment. Approve the assembly sequence and corner finish on a physical sample before bulk production. What dimensions should I provide for a collapsible magnetic gift box? Provide the packed product length, width, height, weight and required insert clearance. Request interior and exterior finished dimensions, the supplied folded-unit length, width and thickness, and packed-carton dimensions. Keep opened-panel or dieline dimensions separate from the folded unit used for shipping. What transport details should be confirmed before ordering? Confirm whether the quote is for flat-packed or assembled units, carton dimensions and quantities, gross and net weights, destination, Incoterm such as EXW, FOB or DDP, and any carrier or moisture-protection requirements. Freight savings depend on those inputs.
